Name: exterior-arrival
Title: Arriving at the stadium
Body: This is the outside of Lincoln Financial Field. On game day, many people arrive at the same time. It can be busy and loud. You can take your time.

Name: gate-entry
Title: Going through the gate
Body: Example ticket: this gate is the closest one to Section 111. Staff check bags and tickets here. There may be a line. Waiting is normal.

Name: interior-concourse
Title: Walking the concourse
Body: Inside, a wide walkway goes around the stadium. It has food stands and restrooms near Section 111. It can be crowded and noisy. You can stop and rest.

Name: seat-field-view
Title: Finding your seat
Body: Example ticket: Section 111, Row 10, Seat 8. This is about what the field looks like from there. When the game starts, it can get loud. You can take breaks.
